g.text: Fault to stored diagnosis takes about 4 minutes, and 49% of it is CloudWatch's 2-minute settle

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Typical run (median of each step), 284 timed detections on the test set. Runbooks off. The share is of the mean end-to-end time (247 s).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: The 2-minute lag is set by configuration (METRICS_LAG_MINUTES), so its bar is exactly 120 s; the others are measured.
